Someone else? The one who was[XENO:n ]
controlling the Mechon you were in?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Yes, that voice.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

But I could still see and hear.[XENO:n ]
I was there [XENO:act act=EVT_EXT19 ]all the time.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Except I had no control over[XENO:n ]
my body, and I couldn't talk.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT4 ]And that's why it seemed like you didn't recognise us.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Yes. Inside my heart, [XENO:act act=EVT_EXT10 ]I was crying out desperately.[XENO:n ]
But you didn't hear me. Nobody did.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]We always believed it was you.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]It's OK. You don't have to say that.[XENO:n ]
I know it would have confused me.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]But the person inside you...[XENO:n ]
Do you know who it was?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]No. I heard her voice when she spoke,[XENO:n ]
but I didn't know what she was thinking.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
There was something she urgently needed to do.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]I understood that much.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]What do you think happened to her?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]Maybe she's sleeping. Or maybe[XENO:n ]
she's trapped like I was.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]I hope she stays trapped.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Hijacking your body,[XENO:n ]
treating it like it's her own.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]I guess.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]I say good riddance, and let that be the end of it.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]Shulk? I don't think she's totally to blame.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Why not?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
She needed my body [XENO:act act=EVT_EXT19 ]for something.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
I don't know what it was.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]I just know it was important.[XENO:n ]
I want to help.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT4 ]Why would you?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]I knew she was using my body,[XENO:n ]
but I didn't hate her for it.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

She was kind. She was taking care[XENO:n ]
of my body. I could feel it.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Really?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Yeah. And she did everything[XENO:n ]
she could to protect you.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
